    Two-sided Hom ideals and their linear quotients #

    A two-sided additive ideal of morphisms in a preadditive category, the quotient category it defines, and the ideal linearly generated by a family of relations. These are generic foundations; the scalar mesh categories of Definition 2.4 are quotients of this form.

    Borrowed from the magnitude-conjecture formalization, files QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution/CategoryTheory/{HomIdeal,IdealQuotient, LinearGeneratedHomIdeal}.lean (last changed at commit 2659d1755), with the namespace changed, the radical-morphism lemmas omitted, and no change of statements or proofs.
